title: S4 Delivery Zombie
description: S4 Delivery Zombie. Milestone 2 credit burn, v1.0. 8-frame east strips, canvas 88×88 (PixelLab grew past the 64 request), origin (0.5, 1). Separate from the live 84px delivery profession. Walk, attack, hurt, and die exported with no edge-clip flag. Catalog-only: no S4 slot in ZOMBIE_LIBRARY_SKINS or SKIN_POOLS. Gameplay wires spawn later and must set frame width and height to 88. SFX keys are notes only; this catalog has no audio files.
